description: Full detail for one standard or container, addressed by its code (e.g. '5.NR.3.3', 'S8P1') or by an `id` returned by browse_standards or get_subject_grade_tree. Returns `found`, `id`, `code` (null for containers), `statement`, `subject`, `grades`, `strand_code` / `strand_name`, `hs_course`, `cf_item_type`, `kind`, `path` (where it sits in the curriculum), `notes`, `parent`, `children` (with gmas/ald flags), `alds` (achievement-level descriptions; sub-codes show their parent's), `assessment_coverage` (Milestones claim, target, points, qualifier), and `assessment_metadata` keyed by assessment_id; the server instructions explain how to read points and levels. Containers (domains, clusters, courses) are reachable only by `id` and carry no descriptors or coverage. An unknown code or id is an error; for older MGSE/ELAGSE codes use lookup_standards_by_code, which translates them.

id.description: A standard code such as '5.NR.3.3', or a row `id` from browse_standards or get_subject_grade_tree.
